notes: Variant WLC.2CH.29.8.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; its qere fallback remains among the readings the English permits and the packet carries no `FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE` mark, so no `added` or surplus unit arises under rule 53.
